about: The first send-approval cards' 13 companies (7 Oct 2026), with made-up names: their Apollo facts, the label each went out under, what the rules give now, what a right model answers, and the acceptable outcome. `us-outbound labels eval` and tests/test_labels.py read it.

rows.name: Northgate Fulfilment Advisors
rows.description: Northgate Fulfilment Advisors is a consultancy helping consumer brands run their fulfillment and warehouse operations.

model_answer.label: Professional Services
model_answer.evidence: a consultancy helping consumer brands run their fulfillment

rows.why: a logistics consultancy: Professional Services, a group not prospected

rows.name: Brightpath Apps
rows.description: Brightpath Apps is an agency that designs and builds mobile apps for its clients.

model_answer.label: Technology & Startups
model_answer.evidence: an agency that designs and builds mobile apps for its clients

rows.why: an app agency, not a games studio: the group's own label

rows.name: American Society of Spine Surgeons
rows.description: The American Society of Spine Surgeons is a professional society for spine surgeons, hosting an annual meeting and education for its members.

model_answer.label: none
model_answer.evidence: a professional society for spine surgeons

rows.why: a professional society, not an employer we prospect

rows.name: Lakeside Orthopaedic Associates
rows.description: Lakeside Orthopaedic Associates is an orthopedic practice offering surgery and sports medicine to patients.

model_answer.label: Healthcare
model_answer.evidence: an orthopedic practice offering surgery and sports medicine to patients

rows.name: Ledgerchain Labs
rows.description: Ledgerchain Labs builds trading and custody infrastructure for cryptocurrency exchanges.

model_answer.label: Fintech
model_answer.evidence: builds trading and custody infrastructure for cryptocurrency exchanges

rows.why: a crypto firm Apollo tagged marketing technology

rows.name: Ironcore Data Centers
rows.description: Ironcore Data Centers operates colocation data centers for enterprise customers.

model_answer.label: Technology & Startups
model_answer.evidence: operates colocation data centers for enterprise customers

rows.why: a data-centre operator Apollo tagged marketing automation

rows.name: Quantmark Financial Data
rows.description: Quantmark sells market data and analytics to asset managers.

model_answer.label: Fintech
model_answer.evidence: sells market data and analytics to asset managers

rows.why: financial data: a medium answer within the group earns the group's copy

rows.name: Labtrack LIMS
rows.description: Labtrack builds laboratory information management software for clinical and research labs.

model_answer.label: Healthtech
model_answer.evidence: laboratory information management software for clinical and research labs

rows.why: lab software sold to clinics: Healthtech

rows.name: Planwise FP&A
rows.description: Planwise makes budgeting and planning software for finance teams.

model_answer.label: Technology & Startups
model_answer.evidence: makes budgeting and planning software for finance teams
model_answer.what_they_do: budgeting and planning software for finance teams

rows.why: planning software for finance teams: not Fintech by the definition, and not adtech

rows.name: Town of Braintree
rows.description: The Town of Braintree is the municipal government for Braintree, Massachusetts.

model_answer.label: none
model_answer.evidence: the municipal government for Braintree, Massachusetts

rows.why: a town council: a public body (the .gov domain says so too)

rows.name: Crestline Games
rows.description: Crestline Games is an independent studio making games for PC and consoles.

model_answer.label: Games studios
model_answer.evidence: an independent studio making games for PC and consoles

rows.why: a true games studio: the rules were right

rows.name: Harbor Creative
rows.description: Harbor Creative is a creative agency doing branding and campaigns for consumer brands.

model_answer.label: Creative & design agencies
model_answer.evidence: a creative agency doing branding and campaigns
model_answer.what_they_do: branding and campaigns for consumer brands

rows.why: an agency: the rules' umbrella stands when the model is not sure of a sub-label

rows.name: Meadow Health
rows.description: Meadow Health offers virtual primary care to patients through its app.

model_answer.label: Digital health
model_answer.evidence: offers virtual primary care to patients through its app

rows.why: the rules and the model in different groups, the model not sure: the rules' label, General copy
